rolled_back: Version {version} did not start on this machine: AIODOS keeps running the previous one.
receiving_companion: Receiving the Internet companion of version {version} from “{from}”…
receiving_companion_progress: Receiving the Internet companion of version {version} from “{from}”: {received} / {size}
receiving_engine: Receiving the {engine} engine of version {version} from “{from}”…
receiving_engine_progress: Receiving the {engine} engine of version {version} from “{from}”: {received} / {size}
android_app: Android app: a new version of AIODOS comes with a new app.
developer: Development copy (git repository): its code is never replaced. It passes published versions on to your machines.
ready_idle: Version {version} installed: it will start as soon as the machine is free.
ready_next_start: Version {version} installed: it will start the next time AIODOS starts.
up_to_date: Up to date: none of your paired machines has a newer version.
offer: Passes version {version} on to your paired machines.
nothing_to_restart: No new version is ready to start.
friends_refused: This node was installed with AIODOS {version}, which does not know about friends: if it took over again, it would treat a friend as one of your machines. Update AIODOS on this node by reinstalling it from a recent version (installer or archive), then pair your friend.
friends_refused_unreadable: This node was installed with an AIODOS version that cannot be read here and does not know about friends: if it took over again, it would treat a friend as one of your machines. Update AIODOS on this node by reinstalling it from a recent version (installer or archive), then pair your friend.
reason_too_many_restarts: too many restarts in a row
refused_start: Does not start on this machine ({reason}).
companion_not_received: Companion of version {version} not received from “{name}”: {error}
engine_not_received: {engine} engine of version {version} not received from “{name}”: {error}
